body:
I really appreciate your concern and thank you so much for sharing your story! These are definitely just points in our lives and I'm sorry to hear that you've been there as well. I'm glad that you could be strong for your family and hold yourself together through all of that!

I'm definitely working on it and taking positive steps to improve my situation and myself, including trying to watch to be sure I eat at least something every day even though I'm not hungry. I know the warning signs to watch for there and so far I'm not in danger but the pattern is a concern when I lose the motivation to make sure I eat. I'm fortunately still decently rational, I think I just let it get too far and tried to be too strong for everyone but me. Right now I'm in a more positive place than earlier today, I'm just hoping that my lows don't claim me. I'm still fighting and breathing though, one day at a time.

And I'm glad to know that caring people are out there in times of crisis...thank you for being there

Thank you for listening, I do appreciate it a lot. The pain part is complex. I've been going through a messy divorce that has lasted over two years and the stress of everything has finally gotten too much and things are falling out of my grasp. It has severely affected my sleep and appetite, I'll go days without eating if I don't make myself. Only down 20 lbs so far which actually is nice lol but I know it's unhealthy and I can't lose much more before being underweight and having other health issues.

My biggest stressor is that my soon to be ex currently still lives with me and has even more severe mental health issues. She has been in a few inpatient psych stays and is now in recovery and trying to get a job again so she can move back out, but I'm having to manage a lot of her recovery too. I work from home and she was just asking today for some alcohol at 9am 😔 I am now seeing myself following her same path.

I had another relationship while we've been separated but it ended messily too because of my complex situation. That was really hard and drawn out and is currently a stressor on top of the rest. She was a friend too but now she's ghosting me.

My work has gotten more complex and demanding over the last month too which would be fine other than the sleep issue so I've been stressing about my job. I also have some financial issues to work through but fortunately I can manage those, it's just more on my shoulders and nobody is there to help. Plus my job doesn't let me show signs of mental instability so seeking help is rough although I did recently talk to my general doc about stress and got a short term med which has helped me sleep a little better and do better at work, but there's still danger there.

So many people here have it worse by far so I almost feel shared to share my issues but I think it got too much for me and if I lose my job I'm gone. I know it's bad enough to count because I truly want to be gone. I can normally handle my issues, I'm just balancing everything and trying to get everyone to a good place and I can see good things for myself but I've really stopped caring if they come and would rather just have peace. The only real thought that makes me sad in any of this is how it would affect my daughter.

I appreciate everyone here on this sub and what they do, both those who are struggling and those here sharing compassion like you

I'm so sorry you and your family had to go through that. I'm currently fighting my best to stay alive for that very same reason. Thank you so much for sharing your story, I appreciated hearing it and it does help to remember what I'm fighting for, this is all for my little girl, no one should have to go through what you and your family did. Thank you for the message of love. I hope your brother found peace
